output.rationale: The trial sources, separate HFmrEF/HFpEF populations, annualized CNT interpretation, drug assignments and composite values are supported by the supplied text. I agree that the abstract provides an undeclared complete evidence set, but the decisive defect is the multi_hop category: one contiguous abstract passage answers the entire question, so two separated passages are unnecessary. The first reviewer recognizes this but treats relabelling as optional. This is non-blocking because correcting the category and evidence declaration does not change the numerical answer.
output.correction_assessment: Adding the abstract evidence set is right, but relabelling the category should be required. Preserve the reported CNTs and explicitly attribute 2022 US prices to the abstract and 75% of NADAC extracted in July 2023 to Methods, without assuming those statements are reconciled. Making the unasked current-price and head-to-head caveats optional is reasonable.
